requests.name: Cc (admin)
requests.description: **GPS coordinates (map picker):** send optional `latitude` (-90..90) and `longitude` (-180..180) to store the farm point captured from the Leaflet map. Out-of-range values 400. Both optional; GET responses return them as numbers or null. Stored as NUMERIC(9,6).

requests.name: Get farm by id (admin)
requests.description: **Area accounting (single-farm fetch only):** the response now also includes `used_area` (sum of this farm's fields' area), `available_area` (`area_acres` - used, clamped to 0, or null if no total), and `field_count`. Lets the UI show "X of Y acres used" - e.g. a 150-acre farm with two 50-acre fields → used_area "100.00", available_area "50.00", field_count 2.
